3cf711e4ae22: Ask: «Ile procent twojej grupy to obcokrajowcy? O ile wzrosły ceny w akademiku?». Note down 1–2 mistakes — you'll come back to them in s2–s3.
8ce3e40e65af: Compare with lesson 01: dwa metry / pięć metrów. The same thing here, only from 5 on it is «procent». You may also hear «pięć procentów» — don't correct it, but say «procent» yourself.
842cdfabb4b6: The key is o / do: «rose by 10 %» = o, «rose to 110» = do. Give the student a ticket price or a rent in Kraków and have them say it both ways.
478a4395d271: The student forms the adjective on their own: 3 %, 5 %, 20 %, 50 %. A typical mistake — «stoprocentowy» instead of stuprocentowy.
b10cc3384b21: Write 2/3, 3/4, 7/10, 0,25 — the student reads them aloud. «Mianownik» is also the name of the nominative case; the student will find that funny and easy to remember.
14db27a7a772: Ask the learner to describe everyday proportions: coffee with milk, glue with water, concrete. «Co» = every third, every two metres.
476ce97607fa: Don't turn this into a separate block — show the item when the student has stumbled on it.
b2e2828bbb3b: A cubic metre of concrete weighs about 2.4 tonnes — a useful figure for the student. Check the forms: dwa litry, pięć litrów, półtora litra.
5a786df5df23: Quick round: you name a unit — the student says «w …»: hektary → w hektarach, tony → w tonach, centymetry → w centymetrach.
7c09e7fceacc: The student reads 5–6 equations from their notes in pairs. «Przez» here = divide, as in lesson 01: podzielić przez.
2631274d2308: The learner solves 5x + 2 = 17 aloud following these steps. Numerals as nouns (dwójka, trójka, czwórka) are normal school language, do not correct them.
89c86439dd31: Have the student find one task with «Wyznacz… ze wzoru» in the summary and read it aloud.
74418257132b: Say the trap aloud in English first and let the student translate it themselves, then reveal the correct version.
097e77466072: to solve an equation (rozwiązać, not zdecydować)
27ee29a1f372: «O» instead of «na» — a repeat of the trap from lesson 01. Catch it by ear until the end of the class.
